Held kitchen garden training for 18 women, offering seedlings and compost-making techniques.

Queue length caused delays during the menstrual hygiene session.
Confirmed attendance and resolved referrals via Sister Person0.
Connected women to counseling for gender-based violence and ensured follow-up meetings.
Shared health screenings results and scheduled follow-ups for referrals.
Send registration files to Place1 for the implant referrals.
Schedule additional follow-ups for the kitchen garden training and health screenings.
